options.reason: The table is one row per TCGA breast tumour with ~17.8k homogeneous log-scale gene-expression features and a single five-level categorical outcome PAM50, so the evident task is multiclass subtype prediction; sample_id is a row key and no other column encodes or thresholds the subtype, so it is the only leakage-adjacent concern and is excluded as an identifier.
options.title: multiclass
